title: Problem Solving and Status Updates
ringkas: Melaporkan masalah, progres, kendala, dan langkah berikutnya
goals: melaporkan **masalah** dengan jelas: apa yang terjadi, kapan, dan dampaknya
menyampaikan **status** pekerjaan: [[I've finished ...]], [[I'm working on ...]], [[I'll start ... tomorrow]]
memakai present perfect, present continuous, dan future untuk laporan status
meminta bantuan dan menyampaikan kendala (blocker) dengan sopan

lesson.text: Di tempat kerja, kamu sering perlu menjawab: *Ada masalah apa? Sudah sampai mana? Kapan selesai?* Laporan yang jelas membuat tim cepat mengambil keputusan. Contoh di unit ini bersifat umum dan cocok untuk tim mana pun, termasuk tim teknis.

lesson.title: 1. Melaporkan masalah
table: [[We have a problem with ...]] / [[There's an issue with ...]]
[[There's an issue with the payment system.]]
[[It doesn't work.]] / [[It keeps crashing.]] / [[It's running slowly.]]
[[It started at ...]] / [[It has been happening since ...]]

lesson.title: 2. Menyampaikan status
table: [[I've finished the report.]] / [[We fixed the bug yesterday.]]
[[I'll send it by 5 p.m.]] / [[We're going to restart the server.]]

lesson.title: Present perfect vs simple past
lesson.text: Present perfect fokus pada **hasil sekarang**: [[I've fixed it. It works now.]] Simple past dipakai bila ada **waktu lampau yang jelas**: [[I fixed it at 9 a.m.]]

items.ex: There's a bug in the app.
The main blocker is missing data.

lesson.title: 4. Menjelaskan penyebab dan solusi
table: [[The problem was caused by ...]] / [[It happened because ...]] / [[The root cause is ...]]
[[As a workaround, we can ...]] / [[For now, please use ...]]
[[The permanent fix will be ready by ...]]
[[We're currently looking into it.]] / [[We're working on a fix.]]
[[We expect it to be resolved by 3 p.m.]] / [[The ETA is tomorrow morning.]]
[[Could you give me a hand with ...?]] / [[I need some help with ...]]

lesson.title: 5. Format stand-up harian
table: [[Today I'm going to review the budget.]]

lines.en: Mr. Adi, we have a problem with the online order system. It keeps crashing.
lines.id: Pak Adi, kita punya masalah dengan sistem pesanan daring. Sistemnya terus mogok.

lines.en: It has been happening since 9 a.m. As a result, customers can't place orders.
lines.id: Sudah terjadi sejak pukul 9 pagi. Akibatnya, pelanggan tidak bisa memesan.

lines.en: That's urgent. Do we know the cause?
lines.id: Itu mendesak. Apakah kita tahu penyebabnya?

lines.en: Not yet. Tom is looking into it. For now, we can take orders by phone as a workaround.
lines.id: Belum. Tom sedang memeriksanya. Untuk sementara, kita bisa menerima pesanan lewat telepon sebagai solusi sementara.

lines.en: Tom, any update on the issue?
lines.id: Tom, ada kabar terbaru tentang masalahnya?

lines.en: Yes. We've found the root cause. The server ran out of memory.
lines.id: Ya. Kami sudah menemukan akar penyebabnya. Memori server habis.

lines.en: I've applied a temporary fix, and the system is working again. The permanent fix will be ready by tomorrow morning.
lines.id: Saya sudah menerapkan perbaikan sementara, dan sistem berjalan lagi. Perbaikan permanen akan siap besok pagi.

lines.en: Good work. Please send me a short report by 5 p.m.
lines.id: Kerja bagus. Tolong kirim laporan singkat sebelum pukul 5 sore.

lines.en: Yesterday I finished the sales report. Today I'm going to review the budget.
lines.id: Kemarin saya menyelesaikan laporan penjualan. Hari ini saya akan meninjau anggaran.

lines.en: I'm blocked by one thing: I'm still waiting for the cost data from Finance.
lines.id: Saya terhambat satu hal: saya masih menunggu data biaya dari Keuangan.

lines.en: I can ask them for you. Could you send me the request?
lines.id: Saya bisa menanyakannya untukmu. Bisakah kamu kirim permintaannya?

lines.en: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

items: Laporan masalah: **apa → sejak kapan → dampak → urgensi**.
Status: [[I've finished ...]] (selesai), [[I'm working on ...]] (sedang), [[I'll send ... by ...]] (akan).
Penyebab dan solusi: [[caused by]], [[as a workaround]], [[the permanent fix]], [[ETA]].
Hambatan: [[I'm blocked by ...]]; bantuan: [[Could you give me a hand with ...?]]

read.id:
Hai tim, berikut pembaruan singkat tentang proyek situs web. Tahap desain sudah selesai, dan tim pengembang telah menyelesaikan sekitar 60 persen halaman. Saat ini kami sedang menguji fitur pembayaran.
Namun, kami menemui masalah. Mitra pembayaran menunda integrasi selama satu minggu, yang mungkin memengaruhi tanggal peluncuran. Untuk mengurangi risiko, kami akan menguji fitur lain sementara itu. Saya akan memperbarui kabar lagi hari Jumat. Mohon beri tahu saya jika ada kekhawatiran.

read.text:
Hi team, here is a quick update on the website project. The design phase is complete, and the development team has finished about 60 percent of the pages. We are currently testing the payment feature.
However, we've run into a problem. The payment partner has delayed the integration by one week, which may affect our launch date. To reduce the risk, we will test other features in the meantime. I'll update you again on Friday. Please let me know if you have any concerns.

read.id:
Subjek: Gangguan Server. Pada pukul 09.15 hari ini, server utama kami mati, dan karyawan tidak dapat mengakses berkas bersama. Tim TI mengidentifikasi penyebabnya: pemadaman listrik di pusat data.
Listrik pulih pukul 10.30, dan semua sistem kini berfungsi normal. Untuk mencegah hal ini terulang, kami akan memasang catu daya cadangan paling lambat akhir minggu depan. Kami mohon maaf atas gangguan ini.

options: A meeting started, and nobody could attend.
A fire broke out in the data center.
The office closed early because of a storm.

qs.exp: Teks: "a power failure in the data center."

options: Buy new chairs for all the IT staff
Change the staff who work in the data center
Close the data center for a month
qs.q: What will be done to prevent it from happening again?

read.text:
Subject: Server Outage. At 9.15 a.m. today, our main server went down, and employees could not access the shared files. The IT team identified the cause: a power failure in the data center.
Power was restored at 10.30 a.m., and all systems are now working normally. To prevent this from happening again, we will install a backup power supply by the end of next week. We apologize for the disruption.
read.title: Reporting an Incident
